decision.observation: 11:30 pm; time advanced but the farmer stayed put. To the west/south-west a grey paved zigzag strip crosses the blue river — the town bridge. 30 minutes of slack remain before the 2 am pass-out.
decision.hypothesis: Stepping onto the paved strip and following it west crosses the river toward the town square and the road home.
decision.memory: The grey zigzag pavement is the river crossing; the sprite must line up with it before pushing west.
